title: Disentangling, Amplifying, and Debiasing: Learning Disentangled Representations for Fair Graph Neural Networks
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating technical biases (attribute, structure, and potential bias) within Graph Neural Networks to improve fairness in tasks like node classification. It evaluates fairness using social attributes such as race, age, and nationality, but it does not evaluate religion, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethical systems.
